global.title: One rate for every gain
global.text: Rate.Reputation.Gain is 1: quests, kills and spells as Blizzard set them. Battleground rewards and Silithyst skip it. A setting, `.reload config`.
global.note: Decided in session 66 (progression research): ×2 overall with the gains moved toward level 20 and up. Not applied.

global.title: Outleveled quests pay 20 % at worst
global.text: Rate.Reputation.LowLevel.Quest and .Kill are 0.2: a quest or a kill far below you pays down to a fifth.
global.note: Decided in session 66: the gray-quest penalty off (1.0), so a player of another race can still earn a city's standing late. Not applied.

global.title: Spillover between the cities and the goblin towns
global.text: A gain with one of the four cities of a side gives the other three 25 %; the four Steamwheedle towns share 50 %. reputation_spillover_template.

global.title: `.modify rep` sets one faction only
global.text: The GM command no longer spills over to the other cities (a server patch).

global.title: Kills give full reputation alone
global.text: A kill's reputation is split among a group's members; alone you get it all. With bot companions it is divided (Group.cpp). A patch could give each member the full gain outside dungeons.

global.title: The client doesn't know quest reputation rewards
global.text: HermesProxy sends zeros for a quest's reputation (only 3.3.0 servers send it), so no addon can show it without our own data file.

hidden_note: The profession specializations: hidden reputations a trainer's spell sets, never shown. Leave.

factions.name: Darnassus
factions.solo: Teldrassil, Darkshore and Ashenvale; cloth, the egg and Morrowgrain turn-ins.
factions.note: The city reshaping (session 66), not applied. The user's main is a night elf.

lore.name: Darnassus
lore.intro: When the Third War cost the night elves their immortality, their druids grew Teldrassil, a new World Tree. Darnassus rose in its boughs, a quiet city sacred to Elune.
lore.sources: C3 pp. 108-109; VG pp. 100, 106-107; quests 933, 2972; the client's description; creature 7999's title

factions.name: Gnomeregan
factions.solo: The fewest quests of the four (22,825 in all): mostly spillover and cloth for a gnome's own mount.
factions.note: The city reshaping (session 66), not applied. Worth a look: a gnome reaches Exalted with their own city last.

lore.name: Gnomeregan
lore.intro: For generations the gnomes built their marvels beneath Dun Morogh, until Thermaplugg’s betrayal poisoned Gnomeregan. Its survivors tinker on in Ironforge, sworn to return.
lore.sources: C3 pp. 56, 114; VG p. 99; quests 2929, 2923, 1072; gossip text 7203; the client's description

factions.name: Ironforge
factions.solo: Dun Morogh, Loch Modan and the dwarven chains; cloth turn-ins; Alterac Valley turn-ins.
factions.note: The city reshaping (session 66), not applied.

lore.name: Ironforge
lore.intro: Around a great forge in the heart of a mountain, the dwarves of Khaz Modan raised Ironforge. When the Horde came in the Second War, its gates held.
lore.sources: C1 p. 137; C2 p. 150; books 1892, 1914; the client's description; creature 2784's title

factions.name: Stormwind
factions.solo: Quests through Elwynn, Westfall, Redridge, Duskwood and beyond; cloth turn-ins after. Exalted for another race's mount.
factions.note: The city reshaping (session 66): dungeon quests ×2, small errands less; not applied.

lore.name: Stormwind
lore.intro: Burned by the Horde in the First War, Stormwind was raised again by its stonemasons. A boy king now holds its throne, guided by Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.
lore.sources: C2 p. 136; books 41, 219 (the Stonemasons); VG pp. 16-17, 30; the client's description; creatures 1747, 1748

factions.name: Darkspear Trolls
factions.solo: The fewest Horde quests (30,000 in all): spillover does most of it.
factions.note: The city reshaping (session 66), not applied.

lore.name: Darkspear Trolls
lore.intro: Driven from Stranglethorn by the Gurubashi, the Darkspear trolls stood with Thrall against a sea witch. They joined his Horde and now share Durotar with the orcs.
lore.sources: C3 pp. 53-54; VG p. 139 (Vol’jin’s title, its chieftain part); book 2104; the client's description

factions.name: Orgrimmar
factions.solo: Durotar, the Barrens and the Horde's chains; cloth; Alterac Valley turn-ins.
factions.note: The city reshaping (session 66), not applied.

lore.name: Orgrimmar
lore.intro: Free of the camps and the demon curse, the orcs crossed the sea with Thrall. He named their land Durotar for his father and raised Orgrimmar for Orgrim Doomhammer.
lore.sources: C3 pp. 34-35, 111; book 2104; the client's description; creature 4949's title

factions.name: Thunder Bluff
factions.solo: Mulgore and Thousand Needles; cloth, the egg and Morrowgrain turn-ins.
factions.note: The city reshaping (session 66), not applied.

lore.name: Thunder Bluff
lore.lore: Upon the high mesas of Mulgore
lore.intro: Hunted across the plains by centaur, the tauren tribes found peace when the Horde helped break their foes. In Mulgore they raised their capital on the high mesas.
lore.sources: C3 pp. 66-67, 111; VG pp. 148-149; quest 775; creature 3057's title; the client's description

factions.name: Undercity
factions.solo: Tirisfal, Silverpine and Hillsbrad; cloth turn-ins.
factions.note: The city reshaping (session 66), not applied.

lore.name: Undercity
lore.intro: Freed from the Lich King’s will, Sylvanas and her Forsaken took the ruined capital of Lordaeron. Beneath it they built the Undercity, sworn to drive out the Scourge.
lore.sources: C3 pp. 94, 100-101; books 2097, 2101; the client's description; creature 10181's title

factions.name: Blackwater Raiders
factions.solo: Stranglethorn's quests and the Bloodsail pirates (50 % to the other goblin towns).

lore.name: Blackwater Raiders
lore.intro: Baron Revilgaz’s pirates turned from raiding to trade. They hold Booty Bay against the Bloodsail Buccaneers and keep its harbor open to all who pay.
lore.sources: ours: world 070-071, the proxy's description; quest 599; the client's description (Baron Revilgaz of the Blackwater Raiders)

factions.name: Ratchet
factions.solo: The Barrens' and Ratchet's quests.

factions.name: Steamwheedle Cartel
factions.solo: Tanaris's quests; the giants' and the Gordok suit turn-ins.

lore.name: Steamwheedle Cartel
lore.intro: Goblin traders since before the First War, the cartel once sold ships and maps to the Horde for gold. Its towns of Gadgetzan, Ratchet, and Everlook trade with any purse.
lore.sources: C2 pp. 108-109, 151; quests 6028-6029; the client's description (Gadgetzan its capital); our proxy's description (the three towns); 1.12 names no leader; no leader: quests 628, 1095 (the trade princes of Undermine)
leader: Run by trade princes in far Undermine

factions.name: Venture Company
factions.solo: Winterspring's quests.

lore.name: Venture Company
lore.intro: Goblin miners and lumber barons, they strip every land they reach, from Stranglethorn to Stonetalon and Mulgore. They answer to no one.
lore.sources: ours: the proxy's description, always Hated; quests 600, 751, 765, 896, 1085; 1.12 names no leader; no leader: the proxy's description

factions.name: Silverwing Sentinels
factions.solo: Warsong Gulch with bots.
factions.note: The bots join since the server build of 2026-10-10 (F0080); to see in game.

lore.name: Silverwing Sentinels
lore.intro: Since the Warsong first felled Ashenvale’s ancient trees, Tyrande’s Sentinels have fought them. In Warsong Gulch they hold the forest that shields Astranaar.
lore.sources: C1 p. 114; C3 pp. 68, 71; book 1849; quests 7788, 8372, 8386; the client's description; 1.12 names no leader; the Sentinels are Tyrande’s (C1 p. 114, book 1849)

factions.name: Stormpike Guard
factions.solo: Alterac Valley with bots; its turn-ins.

lore.name: Stormpike Guard
lore.intro: Dwarves of Ironforge came to Alterac Valley seeking ore and relics, and claimed it for King Magni. The Frostwolves who live there have fought them ever since.
lore.sources: quests 7141, 7241, 7261, 8369, 8375; the client's description; creature 11948's title

factions.name: The League of Arathor
factions.solo: Arathi Basin with bots (world 006 priced its gear).

lore.name: The League of Arathor
lore.lore: To reclaim the land of Arathor
lore.intro: Arathor, the nation that first united humankind, rose in these highlands. Backed by Stormwind, the League marches from Refuge Pointe to win the land back.
lore.sources: book 1865; quests 8105, 8114, 8115, 8120, 8123; the client's description; creature 14983

factions.name: Frostwolf Clan
factions.solo: Alterac Valley with bots; its turn-ins.

lore.name: Frostwolf Clan
lore.intro: Exiled by Gul’dan to the Alterac Mountains, the Frostwolves kept the old shamanic ways. Thrall was born among them; now they hold their valley against the Stormpike.
lore.sources: C2 pp. 123, 128; C3 p. 34; books 1959, 2030; quest 7241; the client's description; creature 11946's title

factions.name: The Defilers
factions.solo: Arathi Basin with bots (world 006 priced its gear).

lore.name: The Defilers
lore.intro: From Hammerfall the Defilers ride to deny Arathi to the humans. In Arathi Basin they fight for its mines, fields, and forges, so that their riches feed the Horde.
lore.sources: quests 8120-8123, 8370; the client's description; creature 15021

factions.name: Warsong Outriders
factions.solo: Warsong Gulch with bots.
factions.note: The bots join since the server build of 2026-10-10 (F0080); to see in game.

lore.name: Warsong Outriders
lore.intro: Grom Hellscream’s Warsong clan followed Thrall to Kalimdor and cut timber in Ashenvale. In Warsong Gulch its riders fight to keep that lumber flowing to the Horde.
lore.sources: C3 p. 68; book 2072; quest 8368; the client's description; 1.12 names no leader; no leader: the client's description (orcs of the Warsong Clan); C3 p. 68

factions.name: Argent Dawn
factions.solo: The Plaguelands, Scholomance and Stratholme: 150 quests and 44 repeatables (scourgestones, writs). Very solo-friendly.

lore.name: Argent Dawn
lore.intro: Sickened by the Scarlet Crusade’s cruelty, the Argent Dawn fights the Scourge from strongholds in the Eastern and Western Plaguelands.
lore.sources: C3 p. 127; quests 5264, 8859; the client's description; 1.12 names no single leader; no leader: quests 5264, 6030 (Tyrosus; Zverenhoff, one of its most respected leaders)

factions.name: Battleground Neutral
factions.solo: Unused.

factions.name: Bloodsail Buccaneers
factions.solo: Only by killing goblins and Steamwheedle guards, which costs all four towns.
factions.note: A joke faction: leave.

lore.name: Bloodsail Buccaneers
lore.intro: Bloodthirsty corsairs and the bane of merchants on the high seas, the Bloodsail plot to take Booty Bay from the Blackwater Raiders.
lore.sources: quests 597, 599, 604, 608; the client's description

factions.name: Brood of Nozdormu
factions.solo: Ahn'Qiraj's 40-player raid.
factions.note: Raid content.

lore.name: Brood of Nozdormu
lore.intro: The bronze dragons guard time itself and care little for the mortal races. Anachronos of their flight helped raise the Scarab Wall.
lore.sources: C1 pp. 46, 145-148; quests 934, 6584, 8286; the client's description

factions.name: Caer Darrow
factions.solo: Scholomance's deeds: a few quests.

lore.name: Caer Darrow
lore.lore: A town that does not know
lore.intro: A plague out of Scholomance killed Caer Darrow before the Scourge was born. Its townsfolk linger, still readying the town for Uther’s visit.
lore.sources: C3 pp. 29-31; Rory's speech (broadcast 6816, gossip 4117); gossip 4118, 7224; quest 5529; no leader: gossip 7224 (once the Barovs’)
leader: Its lords, the Barovs, are gone

factions.name: Cenarion Circle
factions.solo: Silithus: 116 quests, 29 repeatables and Silithyst; Ahn'Qiraj beyond.

lore.name: Cenarion Circle
lore.intro: Malfurion Stormrage founded the Circle to guide the druids after the War of the Satyr. Night elves and tauren now share its charge: the balance of the wild.
lore.sources: C1 p. 117; VG p. 147; quests 26-29 (Remulos guides the Circle); the client's description

factions.name: Darkmoon Faire
factions.solo: The Faire's tickets and turn-ins while it is in town.

lore.name: Darkmoon Faire
lore.intro: A traveling fair of the weird and the extraordinary, it pitches its tents outside Goldshire and Thunder Bluff by turns.
lore.sources: VG p. 98 (Silas, leader and founder); quests 7905, 7926; Silas's gossip (npc 14823); the client's description

factions.name: Frostwolf Handlers
factions.solo: The Horde's Winterspring road: Kargra Frosthowl's camp above the Frostfire Hot Springs, the Arctic Wolf at Exalted.
factions.note: Unused in 1.12; renamed for the client by a proxy hotfix (session 69). Seen to Honored (2026-10-08); the Horde's tiers to finish.

lore.name: Frostwolf Handlers
lore.intro: When the Stormpike dug into Alterac Valley, Kargra Frosthowl carried a litter of wolf pups away. Her pack now runs the ridge above Winterspring’s hot springs.
lore.sources: ours: world 022 (quests 60025, 60044), npc 60110's title, the proxy's description

factions.name: Gelkis Clan
factions.solo: Desolace: helping one centaur clan sets you against the other (Magram).
factions.note: The rivalry is the design: leave.

lore.name: Gelkis Clan
lore.intro: The centaur are the children of Theradras and Zaetar. In southern Desolace the Gelkis trust the earth’s magic, and their war with the Magram has no end.
lore.sources: C1 pp. 144-145; quests 1368, 1374, 1375; the client's description

factions.name: Hydraxian Waterlords
factions.solo: Molten Core and one quest: a raid's faction.
factions.note: Raid content: leave unless the raids become soloable.

lore.name: Hydraxian Waterlords
lore.intro: Elementals of the isles east of Azshara, the Waterlords are sworn against Ragnaros’s armies and wage war on every servant of fire, earth, and air.
lore.sources: C3 p. 118; quest 6823; Hydraxis's gossip (npc 13278); the client's description

factions.name: Magram Clan
factions.solo: Desolace: helping one centaur clan sets you against the other (Gelkis).

lore.name: Magram Clan
lore.intro: The centaur are the children of Theradras and Zaetar. In eastern Desolace the Magram trust their own strength, and their war with the Gelkis has no end.
lore.sources: C1 pp. 144-145; quests 1367, 1369, 1374; the client's description

factions.name: Moro'gai
factions.solo: Unused in 1.12.
factions.note: A free id for a reputation of ours (a hotfix name).

factions.name: Ravenholdt
factions.solo: Rogues: seven quests, then Junkboxes Needed. Our junkbox and lockpicking work touches what feeds it.
factions.note: Look at it with the rogue's lockpicking quests (worlds 053-056).

lore.name: Ravenholdt
lore.intro: Hidden in the hills above Hillsbrad, Ravenholdt Manor welcomes only thieves and assassins of rare skill. Its blades are sworn against the Syndicate.
lore.sources: no book; quests 6681, 8233; creature 6768's title; the client's description

factions.name: Shatterspear Trolls
factions.solo: Unused in 1.12.
factions.note: A free id: like 630, it could become a camp of ours with a hotfix name.

factions.name: Shen’dralar
factions.solo: Dire Maul's librams and books.

lore.name: Shen’dralar
lore.intro: Azshara charged these Highborne with her most precious books. In Dire Maul, once Eldre’Thalas, their lorekeepers still tend ten thousand years of records.
lore.sources: C1 pp. 139-141; lorekeepers' gossip (npcs 14368, 14381); quests 7461, 7462; the client's description; no leader: quest 7441 (the fallen Prince Tortheldrin); lorekeepers' gossip
leader: Its lorekeepers, since their prince fell

factions.name: Syndicate
factions.solo: Hostile; Ravenholdt's junkbox turn-in lowers it further.

lore.name: Syndicate
lore.intro: Run by Alterac’s former nobles, the Syndicate’s thieves and cutthroats prey on the Alterac Mountains and the Hillsbrad Foothills.
lore.sources: C2 pp. 165, 167; quests 505, 506, 512; the client's description

factions.name: Thorium Brotherhood
factions.solo: Blackrock Depths' and Molten Core's turn-ins; the recipes are for crafters at 60.
factions.note: Core turn-ins need Molten Core: raid content, with bots or not at all.

lore.name: Thorium Brotherhood
lore.intro: Dwarven masters of mine and forge, the Brotherhood seeks the secrets of Blackrock Mountain. Lately its smiths have had to take up arms.
lore.sources: no book; Oilfist's gossip (npc 14625); quest 8858; the client's description

factions.name: Timbermaw Hold
factions.solo: Felwood and Winterspring furbolgs to Revered, the named chiefs to Exalted; feathers and beads after.

lore.name: Timbermaw Hold
lore.intro: Alone among the furbolg tribes, the Timbermaw escaped the corruption. They guard the passage between Felwood and Winterspring and trust very few outsiders.
lore.sources: VG p. 207; quests 8460, 8462, 8465; the client's description; 1.12 names no leader; no leader: quest 8460 (they trust very few outsiders)

factions.name: Wildhammer Clan
factions.solo: Aerie Peak and the Hinterlands' quests.

lore.name: Wildhammer Clan
lore.intro: After the War of the Three Hammers, the Wildhammers left Ironforge for the Hinterlands, raising Aerie Peak under the open sky and bonding with gryphons.
lore.sources: C1 pp. 153-156; quest 1449; creature 5635's title; the client's description

factions.name: Wintersaber Trainers
factions.solo: Our Winterspring road: Rivern Frostwind's quests on Frostsaber Rock, the dailies, the kills after the first quest. The Frostsaber in about 10 hours, not 80.
factions.note: Worlds 012 and 020-023, the daily quests and kill reputation by side (server). Seen to Revered on Dwasmith (2026-10-10); the last quests and the dailies' reset to see.

lore.name: Wintersaber Trainers
lore.intro: On Frostsaber Rock a few reclusive night elves raise Winterspring’s wild sabers as mounts. Only those they trust most may ever ride one.
lore.sources: no book; the client's description; Rivern's gossip (npc 10618); quest 5201; world 012, 021

factions.name: Zandalar Tribe
factions.solo: Zul'Gurub, a 20-player raid: coins and bijous.
factions.note: Raid content: with bots, or a solo path to its rewards.

lore.name: Zandalar Tribe
lore.intro: The first of the troll tribes, the Zandalar have camped on Yojamba Isle to stop the Blood God’s return in Zul’Gurub.
lore.sources: C1 p. 70; C3 pp. 123-125; quest 8182; creature 14875's title; the client's description
